Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: An agent skill definition adhering to the SKILL.md specification and ingestion pipeline format.

id.description: Unique identifier for the skill record.

name.description: Slug / machine identifier of the skill matching SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Comprehensive description of the skill and its trigger preconditions.

category.description: Primary domain category e.g. Meta-Engineering, Neuromorphic, Orchestration.

authorId.description: UID of the user who registered or created this skill.

skillMarkdown.description: Raw content of the SKILL.md file including YAML frontmatter and operational guidelines.

summaryJson.description: Pre-parsed JSON summary for instantaneous ingestion pipeline indexing and routing.

parameters.description: Serialized parameter definitions and schemas accepted by this skill.

examples.description: Detailed multi-turn interaction and invocation examples for agent in-context prompting.

references.description: Serialized list of documentation, research papers, and technical citations.

dependencies.description: Serialized list of required libraries, tool declarations, and runtime constraints.

codeFiles.description: Serialized map of executable/scaffolded code files associated with the skill.

status.description: Lifecycle readiness state of the skill.

isPublic.description: Whether this skill is publicly discoverable across all agent engines.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile information for skill engine contributors.

/skills/{skillId}.description: Global and user skill registry entries.

/users/{userId}/public/profile.description: Public user profile following split collection isolation.
